tasks.label: Build Elysiae (Debug)
tasks.command: meson setup build --buildtype=debug --reconfigure && meson compile -C build

tasks.label: Build & Run Elysiae (Debug)
tasks.command: meson setup build --buildtype=debug --reconfigure && meson compile -C build && meson devenv -C build ./src/Elysiae

tasks.label: Build Elysiae (Release)
tasks.command: meson setup build-release --buildtype=release && meson compile -C build-release

tasks.label: Build & Run Elysiae (Release)
tasks.command: meson setup build-release --buildtype=release && meson compile -C build-release && meson devenv -C build-release ./src/Elysiae

tasks.label: Build & Run Tests (Debug)
tasks.command: meson setup build --buildtype=debug --reconfigure && meson compile -C build && meson test -C build --print-errorlogs
